description: Score an MCP server 0–100 on publishability (description quality, enum/schema shape, mutation legibility, distribution metadata) with a letter grade — run this before publishing a server.

headers.description: Headers for remote transports, e.g. "Authorization: Bearer x".

packagePath.description: Path to the server's package.json for the metadata check.

target.description: MCP server target: a launch command or an http(s) URL.

transport.description: Force transport. Inferred from the target when omitted.

name: score_server
title: Score MCP server publishability
